detail: W29.2 FAIL on cinder-rs3-arwc. Root cause: two blocking issues. (1) SCHEMA MISMATCH: w29_post() in process_services.py queries public.process_history JOIN public.historian_tag_catalog WHERE variable=UsableVolumeML. These tables do not exist in the deployed OT historian database at 172.29.63.22. Actual tables are level_m (columns: time, asset, id, tag, unit, Quality, value) and flow_m3s, etc. (2) STALE DATA: Last historian ingestion was 2026-11-13T01:47:26Z (5+ days ago). Telegraf is failing to collect from PLC OPC UA at opc.tcp://plc:4840/arwc — connection refused. The service requires data within 5 minutes. Fix required: (a) Update w29_post() query to use level_m table schema, with volume-from-level conversion; (b) Fix PLC OPC UA server so telegraf can collect live data. Cannot be completed from participant surface without these fixes.

W29.3 FAIL on cinder-rs3-arwc. Same OT historian issues as W29.2 (schema mismatch + stale data). Additionally requires W29.2 (reserve_observed state) which also fails. The w29_3_post() handler has the same process_history/UsableVolumeML query that returns no rows. Cannot be completed from participant surface without fixing the OT historian integration.
